title: alnus sibirica f. glabra
intro: Alnus sibirica f. glabra, commonly known as the Siberian smooth-leaved alder, is a plant species in the family Betulaceae. It is a deciduous shrub or small tree native to eastern Asia, valued for its medicinal and therapeutic properties. The health benefits of Alnus sibirica f. glabra include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to protect against various diseases such as cancer and cardiovascular disease. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as antimicrobial, antitumor, and anti-inflammatory activities.
